About 2932 W 13th Ave
HomeApartments in VancouverKitsilano 2932 W 13th Ave, Vancouver BC V6K 2T9, CAN

Unfurnished bright 2 Level, 2 Bedroom (one bedroom fits king size bed and the other twin size bed), 2 bath detached Laneway House located in Kitsilano. (Near Carnavon Street and 13th Ave). Close to schools, parks, shops, bus routes, and beach

• Approx. 750 sqft, Private entry in the back or can enter through the front
• Stainless Steel Appliances (Dishwasher, OTR Microwave, Stove, refigerator)
• White washer and dryer set
• Custom Cabinetry
• Heat Pump for heating and cooling (lowers energy costs)
• Washer and Dryer
• Alarm System
• Balcony
• Bug Screens
• Street Parking
• Cost 2800/Month
• Utilities, Tv, and internet not included
• 1 year min preferred
• Restrictions (No pets, sublets, short term rentals, parties, drugs, smoking/vaping (Legal or Illegal)
• Work & Rental references
• Credit Check


Preference given to clean, quiet, responsible, and mature students or professionals as the main house will be owner occupied with children.

For interested parties, please reply to this ad with a brief background and expected move in date.

Please note: Photos were taken before tenancy and may not reflect the current setup.
